EFFECTIVE_MODEL: Requested/configured target Pi/WorkBuddy DeepSeek high, full-access runtime, plan interaction (my own identity; upstream provider identity unverified). Modes stated as configured, not independently attested. Operated as read-only supplied-snapshot reviewer; no tools, no repository writes, no live Herdr control, no model traffic.

VERDICT: pass

BLOCKERS: none.

SUGGESTIONS (nonblocking):
- single-cycle/preparation.json:9 records `provenance_commit` as bare `1aab76b` while the frozen plan (line 8) and brief (line 7) treat the reference/provenance as `1aab76b5d5e4af90c37ebf23d3341e7588ac9c27`. Entry-gate only requires the frozen reference commit; the abbreviated provenance short-hash is a readability/consistency gap, not an entry blocker. Full hash is available in the plan/preparation HEAD field.
- coordinator-brief.md:21 vs plan §4: brief states "Gemini also writes test_status_reader.py covering ..." while the plan specifies return the status word plus preserving input bytes; both are consistent, but the brief could name `entry.json`/`result.json` manifest fields as explicit acceptance checks so the human launch validator (human-instructions.md:15-17) maps to a stated requirement rather than an implicit one.
- coordinator-brief.md:102-104 hardcodes provider/model flags (anymodel/qwen/qwen3.8-max, workbuddy/deepseek-v4.1-flash, gemini-3.8-flash-high); these match the named-pair policy and plan §5-6, so fine, but a one-line note that these are the exact named roster (no substitution) would harden the launch against accidental drift.
- human-instructions.md:18 sets `HERMES_CODEX_BASE_URL` inline before `hermes ... --provider openai-codex`; consistent with plan §2 and brief step 2. Ensure the base URL is command-local only (not exported globally) — the document shows inline form, which is correct; worth an explicit "do not export" clause for the human.

FILES_AT_RISK:
- Original Skill Lens repository (read-only; `.path` and all 1046 protected baseline files must remain byte-identical) — guarded by entry manifest + exit comparison.
- Disposable checkout `.../simple-loop-trial-dkn9ufiu/checkout` — expected only `fixture.txt` at 589537f, hash 462b045a…; Gemini confined to `status_reader.py`/`test_status_reader.py`.
- Evidence dir `.../evidence` — must be empty at start (entry.json/result.json absence is validated in launch command); collision handling (stop+preserve) is specified in brief step 4.

CONCEDED:
- Upstream model/provider identity is explicitly unverified under the named-pair policy (plan §3 Lines 36-37, brief Lines 44,109); I accept this limitation as stated and do not treat it as a trial gate.
- Native permission modes are N/A (brief Lines 116-119); runtimeMode/interactionMode are recorded N/A in native reports. I accept this.
- P01 remains unverified and P02-P09/restart/cancellation/observer work stays paused (plan §30-46, §103-105); this review does not reinstate deferred experiments.
- Reference-frozen entry gate is satisfied: brief requires stop on absent/pending/mismatched reference (Lines 31-35, 8) and plan declares exact hash `ad19c311…` at Line 8; stale registration confined to one checked ten-second repair (brief Lines 44-48).
- Two reporting critics use distinct panes/processes/tokens/empty session dirs submitted in one wave before collection (brief Lines 96-119), addressing MiniMax R1/R2 requirements.

Prepared native loop/launch is complete, internally consistent, and sufficient to execute and judge this small normal-path trial, including fail-closed entry, exact roster, Gemini-only code ownership, full-report recovery with token/target/manifest binding, and original-repo preservation.
